description: This file defines the ArrowColumnVector class, which is a Java implementation of a column vector backed by Apache Arrow, used within Apache Spark for vectorized data processing. It includes various accessor classes for different Arrow vector types and methods for retrieving data in Spark's internal formats.

classes.name: ArrowColumnVector
classes.description: A Java class representing a column vector backed by Apache Arrow, used in Spark for efficient columnar data processing. It provides methods to access various data types and manage child vectors for complex types.

classes.name: ArrowVectorAccessor
classes.description: Abstract base class for accessing data from different Arrow vector types.

classes.name: BooleanAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for BitVector, retrieves boolean values.

classes.name: ByteAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for TinyIntVector, retrieves byte values.

classes.name: ShortAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for SmallIntVector, retrieves short values.

classes.name: IntAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for IntVector, retrieves int values.

classes.name: LongAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for BigIntVector, retrieves long values.

classes.name: FloatAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for Float4Vector, retrieves float values.

classes.name: DoubleAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for Float8Vector, retrieves double values.

classes.name: DecimalAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for DecimalVector, retrieves decimal values.

classes.name: StringAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for VarCharVector, retrieves UTF8String values.

classes.name: LargeStringAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for LargeVarCharVector, retrieves UTF8String values.

classes.name: BinaryAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for VarBinaryVector, retrieves byte array.

classes.name: LargeBinaryAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for LargeVarBinaryVector, retrieves byte array.

classes.name: DateAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for DateDayVector, retrieves date as int.

classes.name: TimestampAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for TimeStampMicroTZVector, retrieves timestamp as long.

classes.name: TimestampNTZAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for TimeStampMicroVector, retrieves timestamp as long.

classes.name: TimeNanoAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for TimeNanoVector, retrieves time as long.

classes.name: ArrayAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for ListVector, retrieves array slices.

classes.name: StructAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for StructVector, used internally for struct types.

classes.name: MapAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for MapVector, retrieves map entries.

classes.name: NullAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for NullVector, represents nulls.

classes.name: IntervalYearAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for IntervalYearVector, retrieves interval as int.

classes.name: DurationAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for DurationVector, retrieves duration as long.

classes.name: IntervalMonthDayNanoAccessor
classes.description: Accessor for IntervalMonthDayNanoVector, retrieves interval as CalendarInterval.

methods.name: getValueVector
methods.description: Returns the underlying Arrow ValueVector.

methods.name: hasNull
methods.description: Checks if the vector contains null values.

methods.name: numNulls
methods.description: Returns the count of null values.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the vector and its children.

methods.name: isNullAt
methods.description: Checks if the value at a given row is null.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value at a given row.

methods.name: getByte
methods.description: Retrieves a byte value at a given row.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Retrieves a short value at a given row.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an int value at a given row.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a long value at a given row.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves a float value at a given row.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double value at a given row.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Retrieves a decimal value at a given row with specified precision and scale.

methods.name: getUTF8String
methods.description: Retrieves a UTF8String at a given row.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Retrieves a CalendarInterval at a given row.

methods.name: getBinary
methods.description: Retrieves a binary byte array at a given row.

methods.name: getArray
methods.description: Retrieves a ColumnarArray at a given row.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Retrieves a ColumnarMap at a given row.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child ArrowColumnVector by index.

methods.name: getGeography
methods.description: Retrieves a GeographyVal object at a given row.

methods.name: getGeometry
methods.description: Retrieves a GeometryVal object at a given row.

methods.name: initAccessor
methods.description: Initializes the accessor based on the specific vector type.
